title: Mediterranean Chicken Poppers
description: Spiced chicken mince rolled in rice paper and air fried until crisp, with a dill yoghurt dip.

yield.note: The source gives nutrition per 6 poppers; the total count wasn't captured.

source.name: Firsttakehadrian (Instagram)
source.note: Hype or Hoax. Episode number and rating not captured.

confidence.note: Spice amounts converted assuming the source used 15ml tablespoons (US or UK), so 2 tbsp is given as 6 tsp. Measure in teaspoons: Australian tablespoons are 20ml. Chicken is 92% lean mince in the source; chicken breast mince is the closest local equivalent.

items.note: Source uses 448g of 92/8 mince; chicken breast mince is closest
Ground seed, not fresh leaves. 1 tbsp in the source
½ tbsp in the source; quite hot, consider starting with half

steps.title: Season the chicken
steps.text: Mix the chicken mince ({{chicken}}) well with the cumin ({{cumin}}), allspice ({{allspice}}), coriander ({{coriander}}), cayenne ({{cayenne}}), garlic ({{garlic}}), parsley, salt and pepper.

steps.title: Wet the rice paper
steps.text: Quickly wet the rice paper sheets ({{rice-paper}}), one at a time. Make sure each is fully coated but take it straight out; don't let it soak.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Portion the chicken mixture and roll it up inside the damp rice paper.

steps.title: Air fry
steps.text: Air fry until golden and crispy.

steps.title: Make the dip
steps.text: Whisk the yoghurt ({{yoghurt}}) with a splash of apple cider vinegar, dill and salt. Serve with the hot poppers.

notes.title: Reheating
notes.text: From the fridge, air fry for 5 minutes at 200°C to bring the crunch back.
